name: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
loreTies: Sayo reads how invisible shrine paths fold around Titan Gates. Her maps show safe passage, forbidden crossings, and where battlefields will shift after spirit disturbances.
shortBackstory: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer is the Kami witness whose choices explain how The First Reopening changes more than the battlefield.

chapters.title: Before the Gate Spoke
chapters.text: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer was important before battle records named them. As spirit mapmaker, Sayo Shrine-Cartographer learned the hidden machinery beneath The Sacred Kingdoms: who records law, who witnesses oath, who warns the living world, and who profits when warnings are ignored.

chapters.title: Faction Duty
chapters.text: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer's loyalty is tied to Kami culture rather than battlefield glory. Their doctrine is simple and dangerous: Balance is defended by precision. The story needs them because Titans can win fights and still misunderstand what victory costs.

chapters.title: Story Arc Tie
chapters.text: During The First Reopening, Sayo Shrine-Cartographer becomes a readable witness to campaign consequence. Their first appearance, Campaign 01: The First Reopening, places them where player decisions need interpretation, warning, and memory instead of another controllable unit.

chapters.title: Conflict Wound
chapters.text: The Gate pressures Sayo Shrine-Cartographer through knowledge. It offers signs that are useful but incomplete, trying to turn witness into accomplice. Their recurring conflict is whether to reveal truth early and risk panic, or wait for proof and risk lives.

chapters.title: Dashboard Role
chapters.text: As a non-playable character, Sayo Shrine-Cartographer belongs under Characters and Character Backstories. Their profile should be read beside campaign dialogue, codex unlocks, and faction pages so every briefing feels like canon consequence, not tutorial flavor.

developmentStatus: Readable NPC profile integrated into dashboard character pages.
